protocol.source: Training histories and next training items only
protocol.position_matching: Equal dose, identical ordered original/replacement frequency bins and possible-reachability status across bands; nonadjacent selected positions
protocol.local_plausibility: Every available immediate in-window directed neighbor transition must be observed in training; each edge count must match the original edge's bin (1, 2-4, 5-15, >=16)
protocol.common_support: Score all four plans only after successful randomized greedy position and distinct-item assignment; algorithm failure does not prove infeasibility
protocol.prefix_sampling: Freeze all user cuts with a separate seed-42 RNG before sampling negatives, positions, replacements or permutations
protocol.assignment_algorithm: One randomized greedy attempt per draw; no retries or tolerance relaxation
protocol.replacement_exclusions: Padding, target, all original full-prefix IDs, duplicate replacements
protocol.candidate_rule: Frozen sorted IDs 1..itemnum excluding original full-prefix items except target
protocol.restricted_rule: Remove the same union of inserted IDs across both bands/types from clean and altered catalogs
protocol.tie_break: Exact score, then ascending item ID

architecture.reachability_scope: Possible temporal dependencies including each gate's raw causal summary; masks and learned weights can remove influence
architecture.path_count_unavailable_reason: Input-dependent multiplicative gates and masked intermediate positions prevent a simple convolution/residual path-count comparison
architecture.unreachable_control_unavailable_reason: No applicable occupied unreachable position or no alternative item

metrics.four_category_macro_reason: One category ModelView; equal-category aggregation requires all four measured categories

diagnostic_cost.accounting: Elapsed includes CPU work; host GPU accounting is authoritative

metric_definitions.protocol: Versioned rules printed before effects; only diagnostic corruption pools use training transition counts. No auxiliary recommendation scores or model fitting.
metric_definitions.coverage: Actual users, unique prefixes, plans and failures. Failed matching removes the entire four-plan block; absence is not zero effect. Doses can have different support.
metric_definitions.architecture: Possible offsets include causal-summary gates when supplied implementation is recognized. Unknown architecture disables structural interpretation. Masks may reduce possible reachability. Structural reachability is not learned influence; exact path counts unavailable.
metric_definitions.chunked_rank_synthetic_check: Chunked score/rank tie counter verified against exhaustive synthetic sorting at several chunk sizes.
metric_definitions.identity_controls: Repeated identical-input catalog score discrepancy and target-rank change; expected zero within numerical precision. Causality, all-padding and applicable unreachable checks are in architecture. These local controls do not prove calibration or CI coverage.
metric_definitions.matching_failures: Auditable user/cut/dose/draw failures and pool sizes. A failed greedy assignment is an algorithmic failure, not proof that no valid assignment exists. No tolerance is relaxed; effects condition on successful assignments.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean pairwise item cosine mapped to [0,1]. Near 0.5 means mean cosine near zero; alignment alone cannot establish collapse or recommendation quality.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over valid aligned training-loader positions; in-sample sampled separation only.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of valid training-loader margins; null if unavailable.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training positions where negative score exceeds positive score.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training positions with margin below protocol eps.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Low/wrong-margin counts; category lists empty because item categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.training_prefix_hr10_user_mean: Training-target exact eligible-catalog HR@10 averaged within user then across users; not host validation or generalization.
metric_definitions.intervention_effects: Changed-minus-clean ranks, HR@10, target score and fixed-negative mean margin; positive delta_rank is worse. Overlap is top-10 intersection/original top-10 size. Draws average within prefix, prefixes within user, then users equally. CI95 is exploratory percentile bootstrap of user means, null below two users. corruption_mc_se separately propagates within-prefix draw variance, conditional on successful matching and treating prefix draws as independent; null when any contributing prefix has fewer than two observations. More draws do not add independent users. recent_minus_older is a paired difference on the same successful four-plan blocks, with the same restricted catalog; never assume monotonic dose response.
metric_definitions.strata: Fixed prefix, training-frequency, repeated-target, transition, reachability and displacement strata. Displacement bins are [0,.5), [.5,1), [1,infinity); displacement is measured, not matched. Compare bands only where both have support; intervals are exploratory without multiplicity or coverage guarantees.
metric_definitions.baseline_observations: Clean exact ranks with fixed original full-prefix eligibility, target retained once even when repeated; catalog size and margin-negative count are denominators.
metric_definitions.paired_observations: In-place replacements preserve occupancy, padding, terminal item, sequence length and timestamp positions. Fixed catalogs include inserted candidates. Restricted catalogs remove the same union of inserted IDs from all paired histories and both bands/types; they are not full-catalog ranks. Inserted score/rank gains refer to the fixed eligible catalog. Frequency bins and possible reachability match across bands; path counts and displacement do not. Permutations separately preserve the original item multiset. Neither score changes nor restricted-rank decomposition identify causal user intent.
metric_definitions.four_category_macro: Unavailable in a single-category call; never substitute a pooled-user or single-category value. The pinned host macro validation HR@10 alone selects model trials.
metric_definitions.category_breakdown: No item-category metadata is available; dataset routes remain unchanged.
metric_definitions.unavailable: Explicit unobserved data or unmeasured quantities; missing evidence must not be invented.
metric_definitions.diagnostic_cost: Synchronized wall time includes CPU work and all probes. GPU compute time is not separately measured; host search-budget accounting remains authoritative.

diagnostic_cost.accounting: Elapsed includes CPU work; host GPU accounting is authoritative

metric_definitions.protocol: Versioned rules printed before effects; only diagnostic corruption pools use training transition counts. No auxiliary recommendation scores or model fitting.
metric_definitions.coverage: Actual users, unique prefixes, plans and failures. Failed matching removes the entire four-plan block; absence is not zero effect. Doses can have different support.
metric_definitions.architecture: Possible offsets include causal-summary gates when supplied implementation is recognized. Unknown architecture disables structural interpretation. Masks may reduce possible reachability. Structural reachability is not learned influence; exact path counts unavailable.
metric_definitions.chunked_rank_synthetic_check: Chunked score/rank tie counter verified against exhaustive synthetic sorting at several chunk sizes.
metric_definitions.identity_controls: Repeated identical-input catalog score discrepancy and target-rank change; expected zero within numerical precision. Causality, all-padding and applicable unreachable checks are in architecture. These local controls do not prove calibration or CI coverage.
metric_definitions.matching_failures: Auditable user/cut/dose/draw failures and pool sizes. A failed greedy assignment is an algorithmic failure, not proof that no valid assignment exists. No tolerance is relaxed; effects condition on successful assignments.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Sampled mean pairwise item cosine mapped to [0,1]. Near 0.5 means mean cosine near zero; alignment alone cannot establish collapse or recommendation quality.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over valid aligned training-loader positions; in-sample sampled separation only.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of valid training-loader margins; null if unavailable.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training positions where negative score exceeds positive score.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training positions with margin below protocol eps.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Low/wrong-margin counts; category lists empty because item categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.training_prefix_hr10_user_mean: Training-target exact eligible-catalog HR@10 averaged within user then across users; not host validation or generalization.
metric_definitions.intervention_effects: Changed-minus-clean ranks, HR@10, target score and fixed-negative mean margin; positive delta_rank is worse. Overlap is top-10 intersection/original top-10 size. Draws average within prefix, prefixes within user, then users equally. CI95 is exploratory percentile bootstrap of user means, null below two users. corruption_mc_se separately propagates within-prefix draw variance, conditional on successful matching and treating prefix draws as independent; null when any contributing prefix has fewer than two observations. More draws do not add independent users. recent_minus_older is a paired difference on the same successful four-plan blocks, with the same restricted catalog; never assume monotonic dose response.
metric_definitions.strata: Fixed prefix, training-frequency, repeated-target, transition, reachability and displacement strata. Displacement bins are [0,.5), [.5,1), [1,infinity); displacement is measured, not matched. Compare bands only where both have support; intervals are exploratory without multiplicity or coverage guarantees.
metric_definitions.baseline_observations: Clean exact ranks with fixed original full-prefix eligibility, target retained once even when repeated; catalog size and margin-negative count are denominators.
metric_definitions.paired_observations: In-place replacements preserve occupancy, padding, terminal item, sequence length and timestamp positions. Fixed catalogs include inserted candidates. Restricted catalogs remove the same union of inserted IDs from all paired histories and both bands/types; they are not full-catalog ranks. Inserted score/rank gains refer to the fixed eligible catalog. Frequency bins and possible reachability match across bands; path counts and displacement do not. Permutations separately preserve the original item multiset. Neither score changes nor restricted-rank decomposition identify causal user intent.
metric_definitions.four_category_macro: Unavailable in a single-category call; never substitute a pooled-user or single-category value. The pinned host macro validation HR@10 alone selects model trials.
metric_definitions.category_breakdown: No item-category metadata is available; dataset routes remain unchanged.
metric_definitions.unavailable: Explicit unobserved data or unmeasured quantities; missing evidence must not be invented.
metric_definitions.diagnostic_cost: Synchronized wall time includes CPU work and all probes. GPU compute time is not separately measured; host search-budget accounting remains authoritative.

protocol.source: Training histories and next training items only
protocol.position_matching: Equal dose, identical ordered original/replacement frequency bins and possible-reachability status across bands; nonadjacent selected positions
protocol.local_plausibility: Every available immediate in-window directed neighbor transition must be observed in training; each edge count must match the original edge's bin (1, 2-4, 5-15, >=16)
protocol.common_support: Score all four plans only after successful randomized greedy position and distinct-item assignment; algorithm failure does not prove infeasibility
protocol.prefix_sampling: Freeze all user cuts with a separate seed-42 RNG before sampling negatives, positions, replacements or permutations
protocol.assignment_algorithm: One randomized greedy attempt per draw; no retries or tolerance relaxation
protocol.replacement_exclusions: Padding, target, all original full-prefix IDs, duplicate replacements
protocol.candidate_rule: Frozen sorted IDs 1..itemnum excluding original full-prefix items except target
protocol.restricted_rule: Remove the same union of inserted IDs across both bands/types from clean and altered catalogs
protocol.tie_break: Exact score, then ascending item ID

architecture.reachability_scope: Possible temporal dependencies including each gate's raw causal summary; masks and learned weights can remove influence
architecture.path_count_unavailable_reason: Input-dependent multiplicative gates and masked intermediate positions prevent a simple convolution/residual path-count comparison
architecture.unreachable_control_unavailable_reason: No applicable occupied unreachable position or no alternative item
architecture.readout: maximum nonpadding index; all-padding prefixes skipped
